fields.program_text:
## Registration for local participants

Registration for local participants takes place at the conference venue: Thursday: from 13:00 to 14:00 + during coffee breaks between the sessions

## Regular talks

Oral presentation duration is 20 min = 15 min talk + 5 min for discussion.

## Poster pitch talks

Each poster will be briefly introduced in a short 1–3 min presentation.
